readmeExcerpt: This module demonstrates basic Oracle AI Database Spatial operations over JDBC using `oracle.spatial.geometry.JGeometry`.
highlights: create a table with an MDSYS.SDO_GEOMETRY column
register geometry metadata and build a spatial index
insert point and polygon geometries with JGeometry.storeJS
metaTitle: JDBC Spatial Example | Oracle AI Database Code Samples
metaDescription: Plain JDBC sample for creating, indexing, and querying spatial geometries in Oracle AI Database.
